title: Add --stats flag with greeting statistics
body:
When the application is started with the --stats argument, it must print statistics about saved greetings from greetings.txt and exit without printing a greeting and without asking to save anything.
Output: total number of saved greetings, and the most frequent greeting with its count. If greetings.txt does not exist or is empty, print No greetings saved yet.
Implement the statistics in a separate class (for example GreetingStats), keep HelloWorld responsible only for dispatching on the argument. Cover the new behaviour with a Spock spec.
